More of your work now runs in the background. You kick off a couple of AI agents to fix two bugs at once, then check in on each as it finishes. Now you can mark tasks like that as Parallel. Parallel tasks that sit next to each other in your task list share calendar time instead of stacking one after another.


To switch a task, open its planned time (clock icon or W


) and choose Focused


or Parallel


. Your workload counter counts a run of parallel tasks as long as the longest one. On recurring tasks, there's a Parallel switch in the repeat settings. Sunny can also mark a task parallel for you.


[Learn more →](https://help.sunsama.com/docs/usage-guides/tasks/planned-and-actual-times/#focused-and-parallel-tasks)
